# Changelog

::: {.callout-tip}
## About the changelog
This reproduces the automated changelog of git commits. Terms such as 'feat:' and 'fix:' indicate the type of changes made in each commit. Versioning follows the Major.Minor.Patch convention. The code at the end of each description (e.g. 144d99a) refers to the specific git commit hash.
:::

<!-- Small wrapper that escapes hashes and inverts order for more recent first -->
```{r}
#| results: asis
#| format: commonmark

changelog <- readLines("../CHANGELOG.md", warn = FALSE)

version_starts <- which(str_detect(changelog, "^## "))

# Ensure newline before the first version heading in the header
header <- if (version_starts[1] > 1) {
  changelog[seq_len(version_starts[1] - 1)]
} else {
  character()
}

sections <- lapply(seq_along(version_starts), function(i) {
  start <- version_starts[i]
  end <- if (i < length(version_starts)) {
    version_starts[i + 1] - 1
  } else {
    length(changelog)
  }

  changelog[start:end]
})

# Reverse version order
sections <- rev(sections)

# Ensure a blank line before each version heading
sections <- lapply(sections, function(x) {
  if (length(x) > 0 && x[1] != "") {
    c("", x)
  } else {
    x
  }
})

# Recombine and remove any leading blank lines
changelog_reversed <- c(header, unlist(sections, use.names = FALSE))
changelog_reversed <- sub("^$", "", changelog_reversed)

knitr::asis_output(paste(changelog_reversed, collapse = "\n"))
```
